rule: Nightly storm controller (dusk to dawn, one storm per night, two text beats: zone line at start and area line at first contact, dawn dismiss refused while engaged) plus a two-tier zone bonus rotation (PvE every 7200 s with a 50/50 pairing per realm; RvR realm every 2700 s, never the same realm twice) plus a calendar scheduler that fires once per due interval with no backlog. Defects: second storm can spawn while the first is engaged (UnnaturalStorm.cs:221, :224, :253); two different night clocks (Region.cs:496 vs UnnaturalStorm.cs:217); rotator state lives in memory while bonuses live in DB (ZoneBonusRotator.cs:87, :162, :182-187).
